referents.why: 3mp possessive 'their secret arts' belongs to the magicians named in this verse
3 common plural 'they were not able' is the magicians who made the attempt

links.why: cl4 is not a clause of this verse; a then-link runs only within a verse, and this one runs backward
lamed plus infinitive construct saying what the attempt was done to achieve: to bring forth the gnats
an attempt with a purpose, then waw and a negated verb of being able, is the attempt's failed result, not a plain and
the magicians tried to produce gnats and it failed: they were not able
wayyiqtol continues the narrative line after the negated clause
the magicians did thus, with a named subject, the same deed as the striking of the dust just done by Aaron after the latest command; imitation, not fulfilment
